stepExplanation: The critical angle formula is sin(theta_c) = n2/n1, where n1 is the refractive index of the denser medium (glass) and n2 is the refractive index of the less dense medium (air).
stepBody: The critical angle is the angle of incidence at which the refracted ray travels along the boundary. Which formula correctly gives the critical angle? (n1 = denser medium, n2 = less dense medium)
